row: Hands On Health Massage Therapy & Wellness

Hands On Health Massage Therapy and Wellness is a group therapeutic massage practice located in Cary, NC. Our highly trained team of licensed massage and bodywork therapists specialize in medical massage, sports performance and recovery, and stress management techniques. We use our advanced professional training and extensive experience to provide natural pain relief for sore muscles, injury rehab to encourage optimal range of motion in all the joints of the body, and improved flexibility throughout the body, from a soft tissue perspective. 

Many of our clients get much needed relief from chronic pain such as headaches, migraines, neck pain, back pain, low back pain, foot pain (plantar fasciitis), hip pain (sciatica), inflammation, swelling (edema), repetitive stress injury, carpal tunnel, thoracic outlet, and more. We work closely with medical doctors, chiropractors, physical therapists, osteopaths, athletic trainers and coaches- to get lasting results for your specific needs.
